name: Desire of Fate
source:
The country is plagued by unrest, broken, and recovering from a years-long civil war that claimed countless lives — and left you an orphan 21 years ago.
Your life has been a humble one, growing up in the ass-end of nowhere and then living in the seediest slums of the big city as you try to carve out some semblance of a future for yourself. You don't aspire to much — but fate, it seems, has bigger things in store for you.

As the country's rich and powerful attempt to restore order and instate a new supreme leader, your life begins to take new and unexpected turns, thrusting you into the middle of a deadly power struggle. Against all odds, a poor orphan from the slums just might emerge as the most powerful man in the nation.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/KKpotato69]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个国家经历了数年内战，民不聊生、满目疮痍；那场战争夺走无数生命，也让你在21年前成了孤儿。

你一直过着平凡的生活，在偏远乡野长大，后来又住进大城市最混乱的贫民窟，努力为自己争取一点未来。你没有太多奢望……可命运似乎另有安排。

当这个国家的富豪与权贵试图恢复秩序、拥立新的最高领袖时，你的生活开始出现意想不到的转变，将你卷入一场致命的权力斗争。一个来自贫民窟的孤儿，或许会在万般逆境中成为这个国家最有权势的人。
